recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: literacy scores drifting downward across classrooms
garden soil and calloused hands making a quiet comeback
forgotten HTML tags still buried in the web's attic
clear autumn night settling over the bay
first chill creeping in before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Excavate layers of deprecated HTML from a crumbling webpage — tap to peel back blink tags, marquees, and font elements before the whole page collapses into a 404.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: tap to strip nested tag layers
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each peel reveals a ridiculous vintage snippet worth one more dig
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: page auto-decays faster while tags nest deeper and multiply
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: amber CRT phosphor with flickering monospace

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag furrows through autumn soil and release to sow seeds — sprouts must break surface before a frost line sweeps down from the top of the screen.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: draw furrow path then release to plant
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying soil trail and instant sprout pop on release
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: frost descends faster while seed types need longer furrows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor dirt smears and hand-pressed seed packets

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Words drift off pages like autumn leaves — flick them back into sentence slots before the paragraph loses all meaning.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: flick drifting words into grammar slots
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: sentences snap together with a tactile click when complete
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind gusts scatter more words and shrink the assembly window
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout library with drifting leaf-words

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold your thumb to charge a CLI spark, release to deploy micro-agents that patch nodes on a living site — ship fixes before dawn breaks over a clear San Francisco sky.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: hold/release to charge and deploy repair bots
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: cascade of tiny fixes lighting up nodes in satisfying chains
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more bugs spawn per wave while charge time shrinks
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe nodes against a deep clear night gradient
